Definition: a multitude; also offspring; specifically interest (on capital)
BiblicalUsage: 1) increase, great number, multitude, greatness; 1a) increase; 1a1) of family; 1a2) increment, interest, usury; 1b) great number (of people); 1c) greatness (of wisdom)
